notes.title: UPDATE NOTE 1.3.4
notes.content:
1. Improved game start intro
- The intro content has been revised overall and modified to show animations of the main character's entry.

2. Added voice
- Added voice files for the main character and the mansion's owner.

3. Improved tutorial
- The tutorial available when starting the game for the first time has been improved to make it easier to understand the game's progression that was previously difficult to understand.

notes.title: 1.3.3 Bug Fix
notes.content:
1.3.3
- Changed formula for number of camera shots
- Normalize the sound level of the distribution box
- Changed camera shooting count notation error
- Fixed random item creation crash error

notes.title: 1.3.1 patch
notes.content:
[h1]Error correction[/h1]
- Random spawn of plates, hammers, keys, etc.
- Add dialogue
- Fixed intro order error
- Save only new time records
- Fixed issue with major items disappearing after collision

notes.title: 1.3.0 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44845438/204ef5a67dfbc933b4d8ba9f525ba7ddacdd798b.png[/img][h2]Hello. We updated the game based on Gamer experience.[/h2]
[h2]Thank you for sharing your valuable play and experience.[/h2]

[list]
[*] - Difficulty details adjusted and changed
[*] - Added settings window contents
[*] - Add shader to display items
[*] - Added goal guidance UI
[*] - Added number of souls according to difficulty level
[*] - Difficulty significantly lowered from ‘Easy’
[*] - Added camera battery and soul count UI
[*] - Change font
[*] - Simple addition of initial controls and story line
[*] - Sound normalization
[*] - Placement of items that can reduce camera damage
[*] - Added soul appearance
[*] - Add and change dialogue text
[*] - Added ending event when completing normal or higher difficulty
[*] - ‘Sit Key’ => Changed to ‘Breath Hold + Sit’
[*] - Operation 'Shift' => Changed to running
[*] - Change the appearance of the Negro and add a death event
[*]
[*] - Other detailed changes
[/list]

[b]Information on difficulty level can be found at the link below.[/b]
[u]https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_16Vw8_9VKbduI1U9U_X2Q-rZKbvq2fuR5DIQ1L5Ev0/edit?usp=sharing[/u]

[b]+ All sounds that appear in the game were found after searching on “FreeSound.” Only CC0 posts were used.[/b]

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Patch
notes.content:
0. Reorganized mouse operation feel and increased sensitivity to ease movement
- The existing mouse movement was not smooth as it was not frame-by-frame, so this was changed.
- The sensitivity of opening the door with the wheel was too low, so increase the sensitivity.

1. Intro reorganization
- Supplement to the existing intro narrative

2. Increased residence time after the evil monster’s tour
- Difficulty is increased by increasing the difficulty from easy to 2 to 3 seconds with a short stay time of 1 second.

3. Add background sound

4. Add music object

5. Changed the field of view to make it difficult to play in hard mode.

6. Correct errors in time recording

7. Add credit menu

8. Add version information

9. Add goal notification for next progress

10. Library event difficulty adjustment

11. Vault event difficulty adjustment

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Patch
